intro: Innkeeper Farley manages the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, providing food, lodging, and hearthstones to travelers passing through Elwynn Forest. Well-liked and observant, he often holds misplaced mail and listens to the troubles of adventurers on the road.

p: Innkeeper Farley runs the Lion's Pride Inn with a welcoming hand and a sharp eye. Travelers bound for Stormwind, Westfall and Duskwood stop at his counter for a warm meal, a mug of ale and a bed, and Farley keeps order in one of the realm's busiest waystations, pouring ale and serving cheese to all who pass through Goldshire.
